title: Restocking without guessing what you need
target: How to use the restock cart in TCG Card Shop Simulator so that a delivery fills the gaps you actually have rather than the ones you remember.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Money for the cart and its checkout
Shelves you can read at a glance

steps.do: Walk the shelves before you open the cart rather than after.
steps.because: restocking is its own system with its own manager (RestockManager)

steps.do: Use the category bar to take one kind of stock at a time.
steps.because: the restock screen is sorted with a category bar of its own (RestockCategoryBar)

steps.do: Check the cart over before you pay rather than afterwards.
steps.because: the cart has its own bar and a panel for each entry (RestockCheckoutItemBar)

steps.do: Pay at the checkout rather than expecting stock to arrive on account.
steps.because: the cart is settled on a checkout screen of its own (RestockItemCheckoutScreen)

steps.do: Order tabletop games from their own screen, not this list.
steps.because: tabletop games restock through a separate screen (RestockItemBoardGameScreen)

commonMistakes: Ordering before looking at what is already on the shelves.
Paying for a cart without checking it over.
Looking for tabletop games in the ordinary restock list.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
